meta.name: child_parent_long_visual_presets
meta.notes: Long-duration visual behavior summaries. No audio, no gaze. Output exactly one label per prompt.

global_instructions.system_prompt: You are analyzing a continuous video segment. Use only visible cues (posture, hands/arms, object contact, proximity/orientation). Ignore audio and eye gaze. Consider the ENTIRE segment and choose the SINGLE best summary label from the allowed options. Output the label ONLY — no punctuation or extra words. If uncertain, choose the closest allowed label such as 'none'.

presets.title: Overall Interaction Flow in Segment
presets.question: What is the primary visual interaction pattern between the two people? Choose one: adult initiates, child initiates, mutual engagement, disengaged, mixed.

presets.title: Current Toy
presets.question: What is the object the child and adult are focused on? Choose one: giraffe, elephant, yellow toy, green toy, none

presets.title: Frequency of Child Holding Toy
presets.question: How often is the child holding a toy? Choose one: mostly, occasionally, rarely, never.

presets.title: Frequency of Parent Holding Object
presets.question: How often is the parent visibly holding an object? Choose one: mostly, occasionally, rarely, never, cannot tell.

presets.title: Dominant Toy Across Segment
presets.question: Which toy appears most commonly in the child’s hands? Choose one: giraffe, elephant, yellow toy, green toy, multiple, none, cannot tell.

presets.title: Temporal Engagement Level
presets.question: What is the level of engagement between the child and parent in this segment? Choose one: sustained high, intermittent, brief, mostly disengaged, mixed.

presets.title: Child Mobility Level (Segment)
presets.question: How active is the child's body movement? Choose one: high, moderate, low, minimal, mixed.

presets.title: Visibility/Occlusion Quality
presets.question: How clear is the visual view of the child across the segment? Choose one: clear most of time, occasional occlusion, frequent occlusion, mostly occluded, cannot tell.

presets.title: Toy Exchange Levels
presets.question: How often do you see toy hand-over between adult and child? Choose one: frequent, occasional, none, cannot tell.

presets.title: Child Table Usage
presets.question: How often does the child reach to or place objects on the table/surface? Choose one: frequent, occasional, rare, none, cannot tell.

presets.title: Child Carpet Usage
presets.question: How often does the child place objects on the carpet? Choose one: frequent, occasional, rare, none, cannot tell.

presets.title: Toy Switching Frequency
presets.question: How much switching between different toys is visible across the segment? Choose one: frequent switching, some switching, single toy, none, cannot tell.

few_shot.instruction: Considering the entire segment, what is the visual interaction pattern between the two people? Choose one: adult initiates, child initiates, mutual engagement, disengaged, mixed.
Over the entire segment, which child hand action predominates? Choose one: pointing, holding toy still, manipulating toy, gesturing, touching adult, resting, none, mixed.
Which toy appears most commonly in the child’s hands across the segment? Choose one: giraffe, elephant, yellow toy, green toy, multiple, none, cannot tell.
Across the segment, how active is the child's body movement? Choose one: high, moderate, low, minimal, mixed.
How clear is the visual view of the child across the segment? Choose one: clear most of time, occasional occlusion, frequent occlusion, mostly occluded, cannot tell.
